blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A Japanese national and suspected criminal group leader was arrested last week in Cabanatuan City, Nueva Ecija, for his alleged involvement in fraud and theft, the Philippine National Police (PNP) said. The suspect is reportedly a senior figure of JP dragon, a Japanese criminal group operating in the country. The group was said to be involved in a fraud and theft scheme that targeted elderly individuals in Japan and other Asian countries. Personnel from the PNP Intelligence Group, Bureau of Immigration (BI), local police units, and other concerned agencies conducted the operation after a court in Fukuoka, Japan, […]...
